name: Steel Leaf Champion
oracle_text: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
blocked_sentences: This creature can't be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.

needs.what: a block restriction on the attacker that refuses would-be blockers by their DERIVED (current) power at declare-blockers -- "can't be blocked by creatures with power N or less" -- so an anthem, pump spell or +1/+1 counter on the blocker changes whether it may block; e.g. a block_restriction whose blockers filter may carry a derived-power comparison ({"op": "<=", "value": 2}) read from chars in combat.can_block
needs.why_existing_wont_do: block_restriction's `blockers` filter goes through matches_static, whose `power` key is read at _base_pt (the size before any layer), so a 2/2 given +1/+1 would still be refused and a 3/3 shrunk to 2/2 could still block -- the same reason the engine made skulk a keyword reading derived power instead of a blockers filter. Skulk itself compares against the attacker's power (greater power), not a fixed threshold, so it is a different sentence.
